title: AgentChat show handoff message termination for asking user input
body:
For handoff message, currently only swarm team respects it. But we can use termination condition to transfer control to application.

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue relates to agent workflow anomalies, specifically the handoff message termination and transfer of control, which aligns with the definition of an agent issue under workflow-related problems.
